summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled, heavily obfuscated payload unrelated to the package's stated purpose
details: @servicetitan/schema-comparison@0.1.9 declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/... into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio: 'inherit'})`. The executed file `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript payload (rotating string-array decoder `function WV8StW(...)` followed by a large numeric constant array, hex-only identifiers, sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) shipped in the tarball. The payload is not documented in the README, is not referenced by the legitimate `dist/app.js` CLI, and the package's advertised purpose (SQL schema comparison) does not require a second runtime. Installing the package auto-executes this opaque bundle under a freshly downloaded Bun binary at `npm install` time, bypassing tooling that inspects only Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
